items.title: Real-estate listing card A/B - 'Which One Looks Better?'
items.description: A 'Design Testing' card headlined 'Which One Looks Better?' with two variants of the same listing - 'Lakeshore Blvd West, $250 Night, 4.8 (20), 2464 Royal Ln Mesa New Jersey, 3 Bed 4 Bath 3210 Sqft'. Option A is a light card with the photo on top and details below; option B overlays the price and details on the photo with a white Reserve button. A clean listing-card A/B, not date pickers.

items.title: Dating/social revamp - 'Vibe code' to 'After revamp' with a drawn arrow
items.description: Two dark social/dating screens labelled 'Vibe code' and 'AFTER REVAMP' joined by a hand-drawn arrow: both show a 'For you' shelf with Roselyn, 27 (Paris, France) and an avatar row, the revamp tightening the header and adding Follow/Message. A profile-feed revamp told with one arrow.

items.title: Loopsy referral - 'get rewards' to 'Earn Rewards' with a friend slider
items.description: 'Original' vs 'Revamp' of a referral screen: dark-green 'Share Loopsy, get rewards!' with reward tiers (1/3/12 month) and a 2/5/10-friends rail, versus 'Share Loopsy, Earn Rewards!' with a high-five illustration, month tiles and a green friend slider. The revamp swaps a dense list for one celebratory graphic.

items.title: Crochet community - dark post to light 'Community' revamp
items.description: 'Original' vs 'Revamp': a dark crochet social post (pinkskyy95 'She's FINALLY finished!' with a crochet-top photo and tags) versus a light 'Community' feed (search, Pinkskyy row, a photo wall of crochet swatches, Trending). The revamp moves from single-post to a browsable community.

items.title: 'Your Circle' leaderboard in dark vs light
items.description: The same 'Your Circle' friend leaderboard rendered dark (left) and light (right): Nathan 88 Sparks, #2 Linda 72, #3 Claire 69, Pierre 55, Doug 37, Rosa 31, Frank 28, each with an avatar and a quip. A theme comparison of a ranked roster, not a contact list.

items.title: Tinker mini-game store - 'Vibe code' light vs 'Revamp' dark
items.description: 'Vibe code' vs 'Revamp' of a mini-game platform 'Tinker': left light 'Ideas to play. Bits to build.' with a game shelf (Popup Canyon, The Long Waddle, Doge Moon) and My Bits; right dark with a featured 'Bladebound' hero, Play button and a 'Got a game idea?' prompt-to-play banner. The revamp leads with one featured game.

items.title: Lumen social feed revamp - denser header, bigger photos
items.description: 'Vibe code' vs 'Revamp' of a photo-social feed 'Lumen': left with a story-circle row and a yellow-house post (mara.codes, 1,284); right with larger overlapping story circles, a beach post (Jose Alvarez) and a floating action cluster. The revamp gives photos more room.

items.title: Miette food-memories onboarding - collage to bold wordmark
items.description: 'Vibe code' vs 'Revamp' of a restaurant-journal onboarding: left 'Welcome to MIETTE / Create your food memories.' with a scattered food-photo collage; right 'MIETTE / Keep track of the restaurants you loved and the ones you didn't.' with a bold orange wordmark over angled photos. Both close on an orange Continue.

items.title: Health streak - 75% snapshot ring and a 4-day reward card
items.description: A single wellness screen: 'Your Health Snapshot' with a 75% lavender ring behind a white '4 Day Streak!' trophy card ('You've added an entry the last 4 days'), a week strip of flame chips and a black 'Claim reward' button. A streak/reward moment, not a before-after pair.

items.title: Podd - recent activity feed with review cards
items.description: A dark work-feed 'Podd / Recent activity' with filter chips (New 12, Tasks 6, Team 12): Jane Watson 'October Sales Performance' (Sales, Due Today 3:00 PM, +2) and Dave Staples 'Reviewed' with a reply, plus a 'Leave a reply...' composer. A single activity screen, not a comparison.

items.title: Podd - activity feed with a moodboard-saving design post
items.description: The same dark 'Podd' feed: Jane Watson 'October Sales Performance' and Dwayne G 'Cool Design Inspiration' with a held-phone photo and an 'Add to moodboard' action, tagged Design, Due Today 3:00 PM. Shows the feed's save-to-moodboard pattern.

items.title: Boards home - Fashion, Gadgets and Skincare tile grid
items.description: A dark 'Your boards' screen (StylCLI) with a Filter control and a 2x2 grid of image tiles - Fashion, Gadgets, Skincare and a dashed 'New' add tile - above a pill nav. A single moodboard-grid home, not a before-after.

items.title: Dosebank home - health score 203/300 with care plan
items.description: The Dosebank home: 'Good afternoon, Isaac Ayo', 'Your health score 203 /300', tiles 7h 52m Good / 68bpm Stable, and 'Today's Care Plan' (Check Evening Glucose, Exercise Routine, Review Diet Plan) with Check in pills. Same product as IMG-0223; a single home screen, not a comparison.

items.title: Dosebank dashboard - vertical vitals bars with a to-do
items.description: The Dosebank dashboard: week strip over three tall bars (magenta 68bpm heart rate, blue 79% sleep, orange 90% steps 8,230) with a right legend and a 'To-do' card (Check Evening Glucose). Same product as IMG-0222; a single dashboard, not a comparison.

items.title: Ayo.eth - crypto address QR share screen
items.description: A dark wallet share screen for 'Ayo.eth': the truncated address 0x46eM...e033d, a large white QR code with a centre mark, a row of supported-network icons and a white Share button. A single receive/share screen in the Dosebank/Ayo family.

items.title: Skin scanner - 'Vibecoded' dense vs 'Redesign' contained
items.description: 'Vibecoded' vs 'Redesign' of a skin-analysis app: left 'Hi Tobi, 87/100 Skin Score' with a portrait, five insight figures and a routine; right 'Goodmorning, Your overall skin score 87% Excellent' with colour-coded insight tiles (Hydrogen, Clear skin, Texture, Dark spot) and a history row. The redesign contains the same data more calmly.

items.title: Language-test app - 'Vibecode' list vs 'Revamp' mascot tiles
items.description: 'Vibecode' vs 'Revamp' of an English-practice app: left 'Tests / Choose a skill' with Writing/Reading/Listening/Speaking cards and Recent tests; right 'Hello, Carol / Take a test' with four rabbit-mascot test tiles and blue continue cards. The revamp trades a dense list for friendly tiles.

items.title: Health dashboard - 'Vibecoded' snapshot vs 'Redesign' tasks
items.description: 'Vibecoded' vs 'Redesign' of a health home: left 'Good morning Adaeze' with an appointment card and a four-figure Health snapshot; right 'Hello joy / Goodmorning' with a General checkup card and a two-tile Health logo (Heart Rate 70bpm, Blood pressure 120). The redesign pares the snapshot to two legible tiles.

items.title: AI project copilot - 'Vibecoded' dashboard vs 'Redesigned' focus
items.description: 'Vibecoded' vs 'Redesigned' of a work app: left 'Big ideas, on track.' with a Website Redesign 68% card and a Your-work list; right 'Your AI co-pilot keeps projects moving' with a Project-in-focus bar (68%), Today's task and an 'AI suggests' note. The redesign centres one project instead of a dashboard.

items.title: memrbl book app - home vs 'Practice does' sheet
items.description: A before-after of 'memrbl': left the home 'Which book is on your mind?' with search and recommended covers (Steve Jobs, Educated, The Subtle Art...); right the same screen dimmed behind a sheet 'Books Don't Change You, Practice Does.' with 'Continue With Apple'. The sheet reframes reading as practice.

items.title: Social triptych - photo feed, map of pins, and a $850 chat
items.description: Three screens of one social app: a photo feed (Lisa Haller uploaded 4 photos to Bali Trip; Joe Foster), a map view with photo pins around San Francisco, and a chat with Lisa Haller ending in an orange '$850' payment card ('You sent $850 to Lisa Haller'). A walkthrough from feed to map to payment.

items.title: Dating app triptych - feed, Roselyn profile, portrait chat
items.description: Three dark screens of the dating app: a 'For you' feed (Roselyn, 27), a profile 'Roselyn Archer, 24 / Paris' with stats (1,130 / 6 / 27), interests and 'Send a message', and a full-bleed portrait with an overlaid message composer. Same product as IMG-0461.

items.title: Fitness triptych - kcal ring, profile metrics, 50-day streak
items.description: Three dark fitness screens: 'Good morning, Ayo' with a 1,390/2000 kcal ring and Daily Log; a profile (Akwuabaaa, CertTrkAct Pro) with achievements and metrics (95kg, 75kg, 175cm); and a '50 Days Streak' purple-lightning card with Share your progress. An activity trio in the Ayo/Dosebank family.

items.title: Doseback onboarding - 30% pricing, ready state, invite friends
items.description: Three dark-green onboarding screens: '30% - Get 12 months for the price of 6' with feature list and Yearly $2.49/mo / Monthly $12.99 + Continue; 'Your Doseback is ready!' with Set up my first plan; and 'Invite Friends' with a gift illustration and Share. The pricing-to-invite arc of the Dosebank family.

items.title: Running-social triptych - route summary, profile, explore post
items.description: Three dark screens of a running app: a Run Summary (15.23 km, 20km, 1h29min, 15742) over an aerial route map; a profile (Lisaodnni) with Follow and Consistency Pro badges; and an Explore post of a tennis photo with the same 15.23 km stats. A Strava-like share loop.

items.title: Tinker triptych - featured game, Atlantis detail, gallery
items.description: Three dark 'Tinker' screens: a featured 'Bladebound' home with a prompt-to-play banner; an 'Atlantis' detail with Remix/Play over underwater art; and a 'Bladebound' gallery/reviews page. A walkthrough of the game store, same product as IMG-0279.

items.title: LIFE/CTRL - mono routine calendar concept in three screens
items.description: A cream 'LIFE/CTRL ... COMMING SOON' concept: a month calendar (2026.09) with a repeat control; a DAY A / DAY B / OFF block schedule; and a DAY A screen of circular habit icons with timed routines. Mono-typography and hairline rules give it a printed-timetable feel.

items.title: Dev incident logs - light green vs dark theme cards
items.description: Two code-log cards side by side: a light-green 'Hooks: webhook retry storm' with Delivered/Result/Log sections, and a dark 'Auth: revoke sessions on reset'. A theme/styling comparison of developer incident cards rather than a reading view.

items.title: Context menu - 'good' vs 'better' destructive-action affordance
items.description: 'good' vs 'better': a context menu (Crop image, Move folder, Copy to clipboard, Delete image in red) with a round X dismiss, compared to a minimal + button. The clip argues for clearer destructive-action styling and dismissal.

items.title: Astrology onboarding - 'No skills' flat vs 'MCP + Skills' polished
items.description: 'No skills' vs 'MCP + Skills': a flat light birth-data form ('When were you born?' with date/time fields) versus a dark polished 'Your starting point.' with birth date/time/place rows and 'Reveal my chart'. The same astrology brief executed twice.

items.title: Sticker onboarding - Fable 5.1 vs GPT-6 Astra
items.description: 'Fable 5.1' vs 'GPT-6 Astra': two sticker-collage onboarding screens - a sky-blue 'Create and discover ... to plan your next trip' and a black 'Create and launch ... apps' - each with a + hub and 'Let's go'. A same-brief model-output comparison.

items.title: Budget app - crude 'Before' form vs polished Goodbudget
items.description: 'Before ($10k mrr)' vs 'After (MCP + Skills)': a crude green 'Eating Out' budget form with a keypad versus a polished 'Goodbudget' screen (Groceries 438.76 USD, transactions, Add/Move/Spend). The delta is the pitch.

items.title: Goodbudget three generations - Original, Opus 5, Opus 5.5
items.description: 'Original' vs 'Opus 5' vs 'Opus 5.5': the crude green budget form and two increasingly refined Goodbudget screens (438.76 USD, transaction list, green action bar). Three generations of one screen, showing iterative model quality.
